Hi Taylor -

Great to meet earlier today - appreciate you and Priya taking time to walk through your infra and procurement constraints. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Summary: AcmeCloud is evaluating Redwood to power inference for internal agent features (approx 5M tokens/month initial), priority is predictable unit economics and enterprise controls.
- Procurement ask: you mentioned two potential commercial paths - direct purchase (card or PO/invoice) vs AWS Marketplace SaaS contract. We want to confirm which path you prefer and procurement readiness (PO timeline, required paperwork).

Immediate next steps we proposed on the call:
1) I'll send a short SOW draft + pricing options for both direct and marketplace paths (attached).
2) If procurement prefers marketplace, we'll share the AWS Marketplace listing link and required seller docs.
3) If they prefer PO/invoice, we'll capture billing contact, PO cadence, and W-9/Tax info.

Can you confirm:
- Who will own the procurement path decision on your side? (you mentioned Priya might own procurement)
- Do you have an internal timeline/approval window (target go-live)?

I've attached a SOW stub and a sample invoice template for reference. I'll follow up with a marketplace vs direct pricing matrix by EOD.

Thanks -

Thanks Camila - helpful recap.

Quick answers:
- Priya is the procurement lead here and will drive the contract path (cc'd).
- High level preference: we generally prefer AWS Marketplace for SaaS where possible (consolidated billing + AMIs), but some strategic purchases still go via PO directly to vendors. We need to understand differences in lead time and invoicing requirements.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q4 (mid-October), procurement approval usually takes 4-6 weeks once scope and SOW are finalized.

Priya - can you confirm the procurement checklist you need? I believe PO + COI + SOW + vendor W-9 are typical, but happy to let you confirm.

-Taylor
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
AcmeCloud

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood inference marketplace & procurement path (PO vs card)

Hi Camila / Taylor - thanks for the notes. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Preferred procurement path: AWS Marketplace via SaaS Subscriptions is preferred for new infra-related vendor SaaS (consolidated billing & faster procurement) - provided the offering supports consolidated invoicing and PO referencing. If Marketplace is not an option, we will proceed with a PO to vendor.
- Required docs: Purchase Order (we will issue a PO number), SOW (signed), vendor W-9, and Proof of Insurance (COI) for contracts > $75k. For Marketplace, we still need an executed Marketplace contract and an invoice that references the AcmeCloud PO number.
- Timeline: once we have an SOW and marketplace terms, procurement needs about 3-5 weeks to approve (assuming no legal redlines). If direct PO path, plan for 4-6 weeks.

I've attached our PO template for your reference. Please also provide Redwood's legal entity name, billing address, and W-9.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Procurement Lead
AcmeCloud
procurement@acmecloud.com
